changelog: Beta, database list for ONT 16S: Emu databases only are matched (emu_db_mar2026 first and preselected, then emu_silva, emu_v7v8; …/prep copies last). emu_db_mar2026 was missing from the list altogether — its file is species_taxid.fasta, which the amplicon rule hides — and a DADA2 SILVA trainset was preselected instead. Illumina markers no longer list Emu folders as matches. No backend change.

previous.changelog: ONT 16S merge mode (Beta): picking folders now ADDS to the selection instead of replacing it, so sample folders can be picked one by one (Sample_L21, then Sample_PGU-16S full…); picking the delivery folder itself still takes every sample at once. New 'Clear selection' button. No backend change.
